findings: Owner request 2026-11-10: practice short questions for Unit 11 in the same format as the other books' chapter practice, long questions in the Mathematics Board Section-II shape (5-mark parts) (English and Roman Urdu), written from the unit; not printed in the book. 42 questions numbered 1-42; by section: 11.1 3, 11.1.1 3, 11.1.2 2, 11.1.3 2, 11.2 6, 11.3 6, 11.4 4, 11.4.1 1, 11.4.2 3, 11.4.3 2, 11.4.4 2, 11.5 5, 11.5.1 3.

Covers Unit 11 in book order (11.1 to 11.5.1). Functions and numbers are changed from the book's examples and exercises; every answer was checked by computation in Python (sympy/numpy). Book corrections followed: the minimum of cos x is -1; with b < 0 the maximum is where the sine or cosine is -1; 0 < x <= 1 for the secant range.
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
